To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the thermoelectric performance of solution-processed PbTe/PbSe/PbS NC thin films can be improved by interface engineering.

the interface engineering in PbTe nanocrystals (NCs) thin films by ethylenediane ligand exchange and PbTe/PbSe NCs heterostructure can significantly enhance the thermoelectric properties of PbTe NCs films.

solution-processed PbTe/PbSe/PbS NC thin films with a heterostructured configuration exhibit an optimized ZT value of 0.30 at 405 K, which is a significant enhancement of the thermoelectric performance of NC films.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the thermoelectric properties of solution processed PbTe NC films.
the thermoelectric performance of solution‐processed PbTe/PbTe/PbS nanocrystal ( NC) thin films.
the thermoelectric properties of PbS/PbSe/PbTe heterostructures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this work provides an effective approach to improve thermoelectric properties of solution-processed NC thin films.
the use of a heterostructure of two materials with different bandgaps, and different band offsets, can be a viable method to increase the ZT value.
the thermoelectric performance of solution-processed nanocrystal thin films can be improved by the interface engineering.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new method to enhance the thermoelectric properties of nanocrystal thin films by interface engineering.

by combining solution-processed PbTe and PbS nanocrystal thin films, we successfully achieved an optimized ZT value of 0.30 at 405 K, which is comparable to the best reported values for PbTe thin films prepared via other methods.
we successfully fabricated high-performance solution processed PbS/PbTe heterostructures for thermoelectric devices, which is a significant improvement over the previous work.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the interface engineering in solution‐processed PbTe NC thin films is a promising approach toward high performance thermoelectric materials.
the interface engineering of solution-processed NC films can be used as an efficient approach to enhance thermoelectric performance.
the interfacial engineering of solution-processed NC films is a promising approach to achieve high ZT values.
